Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Jeff Samardzija?

Jeff Samardzija is 41 years old.

When was Jeff Samardzija born?

Jeff Samardzija was born on January 23, 1985.

Where was Jeff Samardzija born?

Jeff Samardzija was born in Merrillville, IN.

How tall is Jeff Samardzija?

Jeff Samardzija is 6-4 (193 cm) tall.

How much did Jeff Samardzija weigh when playing?

Jeff Samardzija weighed 233 lbs (105 kg) when playing.

How many seasons did Jeff Samardzija play?

Jeff Samardzija played 13 seasons.

Is Jeff Samardzija in the Hall of Fame?

Jeff Samardzija has not been elected into the Hall of Fame.

When was Jeff Samardzija drafted?

Jeff Samardzija was drafted by the Chicago Cubs in the 5th round of the 2006 MLB June Amateur Draft from University of Notre Dame (South Bend, IN).

What position did Jeff Samardzija play?

Jeff Samardzija was a Pitcher.

How many strikeouts did Jeff Samardzija have?

Jeff Samardzija had 1,449 strikeouts over his career.

How many teams has Jeff Samardzija played for?

Jeff Samardzija played for 4 teams; the Chicago Cubs, Chicago White Sox, Oakland Athletics and San Francisco Giants.

How many World Series has Jeff Samardzija won?

Jeff Samardzija has never won a World Series.

When did Jeff Samardzija retire?

Jeff Samardzija last played in 2020.

What are Jeff Samardzija's nicknames?

Shark is a nickname for Jeff Samardzija.
